title: 小林製薬、株式非公開化を検討 ファンドから買収提案｜四国新聞WEB朝刊 - shikoku-np.co.jp

background.headline: Kobayashi shareholders approve shift to audit committee structure, reject Oasis's governance proposals
background.summary: At Kobayashi Pharmaceutical's March 27, 2026 annual general meeting, shareholders rejected the three remaining shareholder proposals from top shareholder Oasis Management on board chair governance, reporting to outside directors and quality and safety rules, and approved the company's proposal to move to a company with an audit and supervisory committee.
background.summary_ja: 小林製薬は2026年3月27日の定時株主総会で、筆頭株主オアシス・マネジメントが出した取締役会議長や社外取締役への報告、品質・安全管理に関する3件の株主提案をいずれも否決し、会社提案の監査等委員会設置会社への移行を可決した。

background.headline: Oasis withdraws one of four shareholder proposals ahead of Kobayashi's AGM
background.summary: Ahead of the March 2026 annual meeting, Oasis Management withdrew one of the four shareholder proposals it had submitted to Kobayashi Pharmaceutical, which had included the election of an outside statutory auditor.
background.summary_ja: 小林製薬の定時株主総会を前に、筆頭株主オアシス・マネジメントは社外監査役の選任などを含む4件の株主提案のうち1件を取り下げた。

background.headline: Oasis submits shareholder proposals to Kobayashi ahead of 2026 annual meeting
background.summary: Oasis Management submitted shareholder proposals to Kobayashi Pharmaceutical for the company's 2026 annual general meeting, including the election of an outside statutory auditor and changes to the board chair provision.
background.summary_ja: オアシス・マネジメントは2026年の定時株主総会に向け、小林製薬に社外監査役の選任や取締役会議長条項の変更などを求める株主提案を提出した。

background.headline: Oasis raises stake to 13.74%, becomes Kobayashi's largest shareholder
background.summary: Hong Kong-based activist fund Oasis Management increased its voting stake in Kobayashi Pharmaceutical to 13.74% as of late December 2025, overtaking the founding family to become the company's largest shareholder.
background.summary_ja: 香港系の物言う株主オアシス・マネジメントは2025年12月末時点で小林製薬の議決権保有比率を13.74%に引き上げ、創業家を上回り筆頭株主となった。

background.headline: First hearing held in Oasis's shareholder derivative suit over Kobayashi's red-yeast-rice scandal
background.summary: The Osaka District Court held the first hearing in Oasis Management's shareholder derivative lawsuit seeking to hold Kobayashi Pharmaceutical's directors accountable for the 2024 beni-koji (red yeast rice) supplement health scare.
background.summary_ja: 大阪地方裁判所で、小林製薬の紅麹サプリメント健康被害問題を巡り取締役の責任を追及するオアシス・マネジメントの株主代表訴訟の第1回口頭弁論が開かれた。
